title: padus pensylvanica
intro: Padus pensylvanica, commonly known as Chokeberry, is a deciduous shrub native to North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that help in reducing the risk of cardiovascular disease, diabetes, and certain types of cancer. The therapeutic actions of Chokeberry are attributed to its ability to modulate immune responses, exhibit anti-inflammatory and anti-oxidative effects, and its potential to influence the gut microbiome. The bioactive constituents of Padus pensylvanica include anthocyanins, phenolic acids, and other polyphenolic compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
